**Pol** lets you use the SIM cards in your Android phone from an iPhone or another Android phone, over an encrypted Bluetooth link. No server, account or internet.

> ⚠️ **Early test release (pre-release).** The apps build and pass their automated tests, but have **not yet been tested on real phones**. Please report what works and what doesn't in Issues.
>
> The APKs in this release are signed with a test key. A later release signed with the final key will require uninstalling this one first (and pairing again).

### Files
| File | Install on |
|---|---|
| `Pol-Gateway-<version>.apk` | The Android phone that holds the SIM cards (Android 8+; call audio needs Android 13+ and Shizuku) |
| `Pol-<version>-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone (iOS 18+), sideloaded with your own Apple ID via Sideloadly, SideStore or AltStore |
| `Pol-<version>.apk` | An Android phone used as the client (Android 12+) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

### Install and setup
[English guide](https://github.com/amirhosseintowfighi/tel-bridge/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md) · [راهنمای فارسی](https://github.com/amirhosseintowfighi/tel-bridge/blob/main/docs/fa/README.md)

<div dir="rtl">

**پل** سیم‌کارت‌های گوشی اندرویدی را روی آیفون یا گوشی اندرویدی دیگر، از راه بلوتوث رمزنگاری‌شده، در دسترس می‌گذارد. این **نسخهٔ آزمایشی** است: ساخته و تست خودکار شده، ولی هنوز روی گوشی واقعی آزمایش نشده است.
